This page lists the English versions of the slide decks for the *Cyberboswachters* handbook (*Cyber Rangers*). Translations are added incrementally — chapters not listed here are currently only available in Dutch (see the [Dutch slides overview](../overzicht.html)).

:::note
Translations are made using machine translation and may contain errors. If you find any mistakes or have suggestions for improvement, please let us know.
:::
